knowledge:
- key_parameters: k=Multiplier for the measurement error to determine the threshold of significance for the effect of stimuli and inhibitors in FEED ;; measErr=Vector of measurement errors used to assess link relevance ;; integrFac=Multiplicative factor to prioritize PKN links over integrated data-driven links during optimization ;; mseThresh=Mean Squared Error threshold above which a measurement is considered poorly-fitted ;; DDN=Boolean indicating whether to infer links from data-alone using the FEED algorithm in dynamic feeder ;; pathLength=Maximum path length for database search in dynamic feeder ;; penFactor_k=Penalty factor for new links in dynamic feeder parameter estimation
- alternatives: FEED=Native method in makeBTables, best for cause-effect network inference from perturbation experiments ;; MIinference=Uses minet package for mutual information-based network inference (ARACNE, CLR); prefer for steady-state data ;; Binference=Uses catnet package for Bayesian network inference; prefer for probabilistic relationships ;; OmniPathR=Alternative to the built-in database to download curated pathway interactions directly from OmniPath
- when_to_use: Use when you have a prior knowledge network (PKN) and perturbation data (e.g., phosphoproteomics) and want to systematically identify and integrate missing functional links to improve the model's fit to the experimental data.
- pitfalls: Overfitting when integrating new links without applying sufficiently high penalty factors (penFactor_k, penFactorPIN_k, penFactor_tau) ;; Using MIinference or Binference with multiple time-point data, as they expect only a single steady-state data point per experimental condition ;; Failing to provide Uniprot IDs when using protein-protein interaction networks (PIN) for weighting.

workflows.name: static_boolean_integration
workflows.intent: Infer a data-driven network, integrate it with a compressed prior knowledge network, weight the integrated links (optionally using a PPI network), and train the model using a genetic algorithm.
input: DreamModel (Prior knowledge network model in CNO format)
PPINigraph (Optional igraph object representing protein-protein interactions)
UniprotIDdream (Optional list mapping model nodes to Uniprot IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Infer data-driven network (DDN) using makeBTables ;; 2. Rank links using linksRanking ;; 3. Preprocess and compress the PKN using preprocessing ;; 4. Map and integrate the DDN to the compressed model using mapBTables2model ;; 5. Weight the integrated links using weighting ;; 6. Train the weighted model using gaBinaryT1W ;; 7. Plot the optimized model and fit using plotModel and cutAndPlotResultsT1
workflows.code:
BTable <- makeBTables(CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, k=2, measErr=c(0.1, 0))
Lrank <- linksRanking(CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, measErr=c(0.1, 0), savefile=FALSE)
model<-preprocessing(data=CNOlistDREAM, model=DreamModel)
modelIntegr <- mapBTables2model(BTable=BTable,model=model,allInter=TRUE)
modelIntegr$reacID[modelIntegr$indexIntegr]
plotModel(model=modelIntegr, CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, indexIntegr=modelIntegr$indexIntegr)
modelIntegrWeight <- weighting(modelIntegr=modelIntegr, PKNmodel=DreamModel, CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, integrFac=10)
modelIntegrWeight <- weighting(modelIntegr=modelIntegr, PKNmodel=DreamModel, CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, integrFac=10, UniprotID=UniprotIDdream, PPI=PPINigraph)
DreamT1opt<-gaBinaryT1W(CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, model=modelIntegrWeight, maxGens=2, popSize=5, verbose=FALSE)
plotModel(model=modelIntegrWeight, CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, bString=DreamT1opt$bString)
cutAndPlotResultsT1(model=modelIntegrWeight, CNOlist=CNOlistDREAM, bString=DreamT1opt$bString)

workflows.name: dynamic_feeder_ode
workflows.intent: Identify poorly-fitted measurements in a dynamic ODE model, search for missing links in a database or infer them from data, integrate them, and perform parameter estimation with penalties.
input: database (Matrix of source, sign, and target interactions from pathway databases)
workflows.stages: 1. Create ODE parameters using createLBodeContPars ;; 2. Estimate parameters for the initial model using parEstimationLBode ;; 3. Simulate and plot initial fit using plotLBodeFitness ;; 4. Identify poorly-fitted measurements using identifyMisfitIndices ;; 5. Build feeder object using buildFeederObjectDynamic ;; 6. Integrate links using integrateLinks ;; 7. Run dynamic feeder optimization with penalties using runDynamicFeeder ;; 8. Plot final fit using plotLBodeFitness
workflows.code:
ode_parameters=createLBodeContPars(model, LB_n = 1, LB_k = 0, LB_tau = 0, UB_n = 3, UB_k = 1, UB_tau = 1, default_n = 3, default_k = 0.5, default_tau = 0.01, opt_n = FALSE, opt_k = TRUE, opt_tau = TRUE, random = TRUE)
opt_pars=parEstimationLBode(CNOlistToy_Gene, model, method="essm", ode_parameters=ode_parameters, paramsSSm=paramsSSm)
simData = plotLBodeFitness(cnolist = CNOlistToy_Gene, model = model, ode_parameters = opt_pars, transfer_function = 4)
indices = identifyMisfitIndices(cnolist = CNOlistToy_Gene, model = model, simData = simData, mseThresh = 0.05)
feederObject = buildFeederObjectDynamic(model = model, cnolist = CNOlistToy_Gene, indices = indices, database = database, DDN = TRUE, pathLength = 2)
integratedModel = integrateLinks(feederObject = feederObject, cnolist = CNOlistToy_Gene, database = database)
plotModel(model = integratedModel$model, CNOlist = CNOlistToy_Gene, indexIntegr = integratedModel$integLinksIdx)
ode_parameters=createLBodeContPars(integratedModel$model, LB_n = 1, LB_k = 0, LB_tau = 0, UB_n = 3, UB_k = 1, UB_tau = 1, default_n = 3, default_k = 0.5, default_tau = 0.01, opt_n = FALSE, opt_k = TRUE, opt_tau = TRUE, random = TRUE)
res1 = runDynamicFeeder(cnolist = CNOlistToy_Gene, integratedModel = integratedModel, ode_parameters = ode_parameters, paramsSSm = paramsSSm, penFactor_k = 2, penFactorPIN_k = 0.1, penFactor_tau = 1)
plotLBodeFitness(cnolist = res1$CNOList, model = res1$`Integrated-Model`$model, ode_parameters = res1$Parameters, transfer_function = 4)
